name: G Mark Norman

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Norman lists his occupation as veterinarian, with a background as a small-animal veterinarian and co-founder of Bethany Family Pet Clinic.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Veterinarian Occupational Background: Small-animal veterinarian; co-founder, Bethany Family Pet Clinic

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 48

bio.statement: Norman lists the United States Naval Academy and a DVM from Iowa State University.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: United States Naval Academy; Iowa State University College of Veterinary Medicine, DVM

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 48

bio.statement: Norman lists retired U.S. Navy and Reserve service and the Oregon Veterinary Medical Examining Board.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: U.S. Navy and Reserve (retired); Oregon Veterinary Medical Examining Board.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 48

positions.statement: Norman says Oregon should spend wisely and reduce waste before asking families and employers for more, and he opposes DSA tax proposals.
positions.excerpt: Oregon should first spend tax dollars wisely, control costs, reduce waste, and make government accountable for results before asking families and employers for more.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 48

positions.statement: Norman says he wants small businesses to succeed, responsible development and good-paying jobs.
positions.excerpt: I want small businesses to succeed, responsible development to create opportunity, and good-paying jobs to grow here.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 48

positions.statement: Norman says he will work for better school outcomes by supporting students, teachers, academic basics and career readiness.
positions.excerpt: I will work for better school outcomes by supporting students, teachers, academic basics, and career readiness.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 48

positions.statement: Norman says he will support law enforcement, behavioral-health resources and practical solutions to homelessness and addiction.
positions.excerpt: I will support law enforcement, behavioral-health resources, and practical solutions to homelessness and addiction

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 48
